title: Compute reduction (source twin)
blurb: `compute-reduction.ts` written in the source language: the EDSL's `reduce()` combinator spelled as the `for` loop it expands into. Like its original, `compile()` emits WGSL and no GLSL text for it. That is no gap of the WebGL2 tier, which runs a compute entry as its pass program (Rule 11.8).
